intro.title: Bounty Hunting - Burning Springs Head Hunt Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Burning Springs Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and the gang they bring follows the same theme. This page lists every boss by group with their weapons, health, damage and resistances, plus the gang members and support wave that fight alongside them. All numbers are read straight from the game files and update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Bosses are grouped the same way as the Head Hunt Groups lifetime challenges. Track your kills on the Grunt Hunt and Head Hunt Challenges page.
intro.mutations: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.
intro.mechanics: Burning Springs Head Hunt bosses share the following stats.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the bounty level range. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's main weapon at the bottom and top of the bounty level range.
intro.support: Every Burning Springs Head Hunt also sends a support wave that fights alongside the boss and its gang.
intro.npcs: Each boss brings its own gang members, listed with the boss they belong to.
